episodes.synopsis: Now 16 years old, Gohan embarks on his first day of high school. But blending in is almost impossible for a Saiyan, and it gets even tougher when a celebrity classmate gets suspicious of a certain blond man thwarting criminals around town.
episodes.title: Seven Years Later! Starting Today, Gohan Is a High School Student

episodes.synopsis: Gohan asks Bulma to make him a disguise so that he can continue to fight crime in the city without being recognized. Wearing his new outfit, the defender of justice makes his grand debut in the city by helping Videl thwart a gang of criminals.
episodes.title: A New Hero, Great Saiyaman, Is Born!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan teaches Goten and Videl how to fly. Goku continues his training in Otherworld while Piccolo and Vegeta prepare themselves to face him in the tournament. Vegeta is stunned to learn that young Trunks and Goten can already turn Super Saiyan.
episodes.title: Gohan the Teacher! Videl's Flying Technique Tutorial

episodes.synopsis: Gohan and the gang knuckle down on their individual training regimens in preparation for the World Martial Arts Tournament. When the day arrives, everyone gathers on the tournament grounds, where a father and son meet for the first time.
episodes.title: The Dragon Team Fully Assembled! Goku Has Come Back!

episodes.synopsis: While Gohan and Videl wait to take their preliminaries, Goku, Vegeta, and the others go to spectate the junior division, where Goten and Trunks effortlessly progress through each round until they face each other in the final round. The battle gets more intense. Goten and Trunks surprise the audience with advanced techniques. The fight between Goten and Trunks continues.
episodes.title: Everyone Is Surprised! Goten and Trunks' Super Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Satan plays off his defeat at the hands of the Junior Division champion. While Goku and the gang have an all-out feast, Trunks and Goten plan to get into the Adult Division drawing. A mysterious stranger approaches Goku, keen to fight him.
episodes.title: Restless Foreboding - A Mysterious Warrior Appears!

episodes.synopsis: The adult division rounds finally begin! Piccolo must put his skills to the test against a mysterious opponent—but not before Krillin steps into the ring.
episodes.title: What Happened, Piccolo? An Unexpected Outcome in the First Round

episodes.synopsis: Spopovitch continues his savage assault on Videl, who refuses to admit defeat.
episodes.title: Videl Battered! Gohan's Fury Reaches Its Limit!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and the others join the Supreme Kai in his search for Yamu and Spopovitch. As they travel, Shin explains what the devious duo were after and warns them of an ancient evil known as Majin Buu.
episodes.title: The Terrifying Secret of the Majin - The Mastermind Revealed!

episodes.synopsis: The evil wizard Babidi gives his henchmen a rough homecoming before turning on our heroes. Was this their plan all along?
episodes.title: The Nefarious Wizard Babidi and Demon King Dabura's Trap

episodes.synopsis: To find Babidi, Goku and the others will have to fight their way through various opponents waiting on his ship. Vegeta steps up to handle the first stage, but Babidi uses magic to give his opponent the upper hand.
episodes.title: Don't Sell Super Saiyans Short! Vegeta and Goku's Full-Bore Power!

episodes.synopsis: Back at the World Martial Arts Tournament, the crowd is getting restless. With most of the Z Fighters disqualified, Mr. Satan calls for a battle royale between the five remaining combatants.
episodes.title: Whither Victory? A Battle Royal Championship Match!

episodes.synopsis: As Dabura meditates to bolster his power, Number 18 gives it all she’s got back at the World Martial Arts Tournament. She can’t read Mighty Mask’s sporadic movements, but she refuses to go down without a fight.
episodes.title: Stunning Youngsters! No. 18's Uphill Battle

episodes.synopsis: Dabura emerges to face Gohan in a one-on-one battle. With Mighty Mask defeated, only Mr. Satan stands between Number 18 and the tournament’s prize money. Good luck Mr. Satan!
episodes.title: Enter the Headliner! The Looming Demon King!

episodes.synopsis: As Gohan struggles against Dabura, Babidi senses dissent among the Saiyans and sees an opportunity to add another powerful soldier to his ranks.
episodes.title: A Heart of Evil Awakened - Vegeta, Prince of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: Under Babidi’s control, Vegeta goes on a destructive rampage vowing that the carnage will continue until Goku agrees to face him in combat.
episodes.title: I Am the Strongest! The Clash of Goku vs. Vegeta

episodes.synopsis: The rematch between Goku and Vegeta heats up while Gohan and the Supreme Kai head to Babidi’s ship to confront the wizard face to face.
episodes.title: Countdown to Revival, Crush Babidi's Ambitions!

episodes.synopsis: The Saiyan slugfest continues with every punch delivering more energy to the dormant Majin Buu. Time is running out for Gohan to stop the creature’s rebirth.
episodes.title: The Seal Is Released? Gohan's Kamehame-Ha of Resistance

episodes.synopsis: Majin Buu has been reborn. Will Goku and Vegeta be able to put aside their personal grudge to send him back to sleep for good?
episodes.title: Straightaway into Despair? The Terror of Majin Buu

episodes.synopsis: Gohan uses what’s left of his strength to protect the Supreme Kai, and the Z Fighters find an unlikely ally in their fight against Majin Buu.
episodes.title: Turn into Candy! A Hungry Majin's Bizarre Power!

episodes.synopsis: The Z Fighters gather as Vegeta makes his stand against Majin Buu.
episodes.title: I Will Deal with the Majin! Vegeta's Final Mortal Combat!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta and Majin Buu continue to fight. Goten and Trunks watch the battle unfold while Piccolo confronts Babidi.
episodes.title: For His Beloved Ones... The End of the Proud Warrior!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta's sacrifice has left Majin Buu scattered in pieces but not defeated. As the creature regenerates, reinforcements arrive.
episodes.title: A Nightmare Revisited - The Immortal Monster Majin Buu!

episodes.synopsis: Bulma, Chichi and the others search for the last Dragon Ball so they can resurrect the people Vegeta killed. Meanwhile, Goku comes up with a plan to defeat Majin Buu.
episodes.title: A Secret Plan to Defeat Buu! Its Name Is Fusion

episodes.synopsis: Bulma resurrects the fallen spectators, and Goku rushes to ensure she doesn’t use up the rest of her wishes too soon. Buu continues his rampage and Babidi makes an announcement to the world.
episodes.title: Found! A Faint Ray of Hope - Awaken, Warriors!

episodes.synopsis: Babidi reaches out to the people of Earth, demanding they give him Piccolo, Trunks, and Goten. If they don’t comply, Majin Buu will wipe out the population.
episodes.title: Find the Nuisances - Babidi's Retaliation Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan finds a new weapon in the Sacred World of the Kais. Goku struggles to teach Goten and Trunks the Fusion technique.
episodes.title: A Time of Trials! Lay Hold of Legendary Powers!

episodes.synopsis: Trunks is sent on a special mission while Goku distracts Babidi and Buu with an earth-shaking display of power.
episodes.title: Hold Majin Buu in Check! Limit - Super Saiyan 3!!

episodes.synopsis: Trunks tries to locate the Dragon Radar while Goku continues to stall Majin Buu.
episodes.title: True Worth Beginning to Show - The Treacherous Buu!

episodes.synopsis: Free of Babidi's influence, Buu becomes more destructive than ever as he waits for the arrival of Trunks and Goten. Elsewhere, Gohan continues his training with the Z-Sword.
episodes.title: Silly Looking? Drilling the Fusion Pose!

episodes.synopsis: Goku’s time is running out to teach the boys the Fusion technique. Will they manage to master it before he’s forced to return to Otherworld?
episodes.title: Bye-Bye, Everyone! Goku Returns to the Next World

episodes.synopsis: Gohan has mastered the Z-Sword, but Goten and Trunks are still struggling with Fusion. Meanwhile, Majin Buu’s destruction is briefly put on pause.
episodes.title: Gohan Located! Intensive Training in the World of the Kais!

episodes.synopsis: Goten and Trunks complete their first successful Fusion. Will it be enough to defeat Majin Buu?
episodes.title: Birth of a Merged Superwarrior - His Name Is Gotenks!

episodes.synopsis: Gotenks and Majin Buu go head to head in an intense battle, but humanity is calling upon another hero to save them.
episodes.title: Who Will Defeat Majin Buu? The Mightiest of Men Moves Out!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan continues powering up with the Elder Kai while Goten and Trunks fuse into "Super Saiyan Gotenks." Mr. Satan and Buu add another member to their household.
episodes.title: The Powering Up Continues? Super Gotenks is Achieved!

episodes.synopsis: Majin Buu retaliates against his attackers while Gohan continues powering up. Goten and Trunks take a break to regain their strength.
episodes.title: What Anger Gives Rise To - Another Majin!

episodes.synopsis: The evil manifestation of Buu fights the good Buu, but easily overpowers him. With nothing holding him back, he seeks out the opponent Goku had promised him.
episodes.title: Buu Gobbles Up Buu! Onslaught of a New Majin!

episodes.synopsis: Piccolo convinces Super Buu to wait for one hour before battling Trunks and Goten while they train in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber.
episodes.title: Headlong Rush into Catastrophe! A One-Hour Time Limit!

episodes.synopsis: Piccolo stalled Super Buu for as long as he could. But it’s time for the rematch between Super Buu and Gotenks.
episodes.title: Training Complete! You're Finished Now, Majin Buu!

episodes.synopsis: Super Buu and Gotenks square off inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber and Gotenks reveals a new ability.
episodes.title: Eliminating Buu with Ghosts: A Knockout Kamikaze Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Piccolo has destroyed the Hyperbolic Time Chamber, trapping himself and Gotenks with Super Buu. After Buu escapes, the others become desperate to free themselves as well.
episodes.title: Gotenks' Ace in the Hole! Transformation! Super Gotenks 3!

episodes.synopsis: A newly powered up Gotenks seeks vengeance on Super Buu, but Buu has made it clear he won’t go down without a fight.
episodes.title: On a Roll! Buu-Buu-Volleyball!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Gotenks and Super Buu ends abruptly when Buu inexplicably falls asleep. Gohan is finally ready to unleash his new powers.
episodes.title: Thanks for Waiting, Everyone! A Reborn Gohan Heads for Earth!

episodes.synopsis: Gohan tests his newfound power against Super Buu in brutal combat.
episodes.title: Buu Overwhelmed! Ultimate Gohan's Super Power!

episodes.synopsis: Majin Buu returns to the battlefield with suspiciously renewed confidence. Turning his focus to Trunks and Goten, he goads them into becoming Gotenks once more
episodes.title: Buu's Sinister Scheme: Gotenks Is Absorbed

episodes.synopsis: Gohan’s fight with Buu continues, but Gohan is struggling to keep up. Left with no other options, the Elder Kai decides that Goku must return to Earth.
episodes.title: The Elder Kai's Brainstorm! Return to Life, Goku!

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Gohan plan to fuse to finish off the weakened Super Buu. But when things go awry, Goku finds himself resorting to desperate measures.
episodes.title: Miracles Happen Once... Will Goku and He Make the Ultimate Combination?

episodes.synopsis: The newly formed Vegetto adjusts to his new body while taunting Super Buu. What should have been a quick fight turns ugly when Vegetto angers the creature putting the universe at risk.
episodes.title: Invincible! The Ultimate Warrior Vegetto

episodes.synopsis: Vegetto continues fighting Super Buu, neither warrior showing any sign of slowing down or admitting defeat.
episodes.title: Buu's Ace in the Hole! The Warriors Are Absorbed!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta and Goku un-fuse inside of Majin Buu. They are able to protect themselves from being completely absorbed and search for a way to destroy the monster from within.
episodes.title: Rescue Gohan and the Others! Goku and Vegeta's Infiltration Mission!

episodes.synopsis: The battle continues inside Buu’s body with Vegeta and Goku outmatched. When Vegeta exploits the weakness Buu has been protecting, Buu begins another transformation.
episodes.title: Emergency Escape from the Body! Buu's Retrogression into Evil!

episodes.synopsis: Kibito Kai reveals Majin Buu’s history and the root of his many personalities. Back on the battlefield, Goku and Vegeta attempt to stop Kid Buu from destroying Earth.
episodes.title: Earth Destroyed! The Initial Buu's Nefarious Strike

episodes.synopsis: Goku and Vegeta reveal their location and lure Kid Buu to the World of the Kais, away from Krillin and Yamcha.
episodes.title: A Final Showdown at the Summit! Face-Off in the World of the Kais!

episodes.synopsis: Goku powers up to Super Saiyan 3 to fight Kid Buu. Vegeta watches in awe, reflecting on the years he spent chasing the other Saiyan.
episodes.title: Hang In There, Kakarot! You Are No. 1!

episodes.synopsis: Goku goes toe-to-toe with Kid Buu but can’t finish him off. He has a plan, but he’ll need Vegeta’s help to see it through. Can the Saiyan prince distract Kid Buu long enough for Goku to charge up?
episodes.title: A One-Minute Match-Up! Vegeta's Life-Threatening Stall for Time!

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Satan stands up to Kid Buu, causing a rift to form between two of the creature’s personalities. Vegeta sends Dende on a special mission.
episodes.title: An Inspired Strategy - Make Two Wishes Come True!

episodes.synopsis: Vegeta’s plan comes together when Dende revives Earth and its population. If they can get all of humanity to offer their energy to Goku, he just might be able to form a Spirit Bomb powerful enough to end this fight once and for all.
episodes.title: Share Your Spirit Energy with Me! I'm Making a Huge Spirit Bomb!

episodes.synopsis: The people of Earth are still unsure of Vegeta’s intentions. Without their help, the Spirit Bomb will never be strong enough. When all hope seems lost, an unlikely hero turns the tides.
episodes.title: You Are the Savior of the World! Everybody's Spirit Bomb Completed!

episodes.synopsis: With the Spirit Bomb fully formed, Goku only needs to find the power to wield the mighty weapon and save the universe.
episodes.title: You Really Are the Greatest, Goku!! The Demise of Majin Buu

episodes.synopsis: It’s now been ten years since the defeat of Kid Buu, and the Z Fighters are reuniting for the World Martial Arts Tournament. New faces and familiar fighters prepare to enter the competition—one in particular has caught Goku’s attention.
episodes.title: And So, Ten Years Later... A Long-Awaited World Martial Arts Tournament!

episodes.synopsis: The tournament begins, and Goku faces a young boy named Uub who possesses incredible power and a shocking origin.
episodes.title: Even Stronger! Goku's Dream Is Never-Ending!
